ACP is the only production execution path (P70/P21). Harness binding, gateway, device control stay.
Fixed boundary: collaboration/presence/shared conversations.
Fixed boundary: GitHub/Linear integration. Generic connector infrastructure (OAuth, credential vault, webhook ingress) stays — ORV-105 must not delete it with the chat adapters.

Conversation/ChatInput/shared activity/intervention stay as the multiplayer agent control surface, but must not own prompt/model/provider/tool-loop execution (ORV-107). ASR transcription router kept (ChatInput Dictation is its sole consumer).
better-auth/OIDC, gateway tokens, MCP auth, credential vault, TRPC API-key rules — P00 §R whitelist.
Database/storage/observability/TRPC/types/utils — required infra.
Harness-native builtin tools/skills/agents mounted on ACP sessions stay (ORV-104 preserves these; only skill-store-distribution pieces go).
Agent documents / page editor / resource manager — workspace product surfaces.
Desktop/Web parity is in the boundary; workbench (mobile doc reader) and share hosts stay per P00 §N.
User data import/export is a supported onboarding surface (referenced by User panel + Settings > Storage).
External REST/Responses API stays as a supported surface but its Responses semantics must be re-founded on ACP operation lifecycle (P00 §H).

User-managed LLM provider/BYOK/baseURL/model-selection product surface was retired in P05/P06; residual route/store/API/service/locale/docs are swept per ORV-101. Generic credential infra for connectors stays.

BYOK-era runtime tails deleted by ORV-102 (key-vault payload builders, per-user provider access shell, Lobe chat route). The model runtime itself is the ACP execution path and stays under model-runtime (KEEP) — reconciled in ORV-110.

Model execution runtime serving the deployment-owned model catalog — the ACP execution path calls through packages/model-runtime and modules/ModelRuntime. Kept; ORV-102 removed only the BYOK-era tails (see legacy-model-runtime). Deployment-scoped provider content-policy helpers in business-server stay with it.

Standalone Acceptance storefront (dedicated routes + store) — retired; ORV-103 removed the orphaned residuals. The canonical task-acceptance surface (features/Acceptance, verify acceptance services, acceptance routers, acceptance-evidence builtin) is the in-boundary Task Review flow, kept under tasks-caid — reconciled in ORV-110.

Orvilo-owned skill marketplace/distribution storefront — retired by ORV-104 (submission flow, backend market shells, discover browse slices, klavis). Per-agent skill management (AgentSkillStore/Detail UI, profile features store, agentSkills/composio/plugin routers, skill-maintainer builtin) and the external market proxy (market-service) stay — reconciled in ORV-110.

External marketplace product survives as a proxy: market lambda router (agent/creds/oidc/user) + tools/market + services/market install plumbing feed retained tool/connector paths. Resolved by ORV-110 census — all importers are in-boundary.
Non-core IM adapters (feishu/wechat/qq/line/imessage/telegram/discord bot channel) have no current product requirement or owner (ORV-105). GitHub/Linear connector infrastructure is out of scope.
ComfyUI backend + artwork studios + Orvilo-owned image generation are outside the boundary; if image generation is needed it comes back as an ACP/harness capability, not an Orvilo backend (ORV-106).

Agent/RAG eval runs execute through the ACP agent runtime and serve the public OpenAPI eval endpoints; the standalone eval UI routes were already removed before the stack. Backend eval infra is in-boundary — reconciled in ORV-110 (was provisionally DELETE under ORV-108 before evidence showed live OpenAPI consumers).
context-engine / prompts / model-bank are live shared primitives (model catalog, prompt registry, context assembly) consumed by ACP/task/collaboration — resolved by ORV-110 census.
Orphan chaos-engineering toolkit: 7 private workspace packages under packages/achaos/**, zero external inbound imports, README consumers aspirational. Deleted by ORV-115; guard keeps it dead.

Knowledge base + chunk pipeline are live in-boundary infrastructure: consumed by knowledgeBase server runtime (agent-tools), Agent/Project/Document flows, and workspace-permission-gated routers. Resolved by ORV-114.

packages/file-loaders is the shared document/file parsing pipeline consumed by Document service, documentAccess, local-file-shell and OpenAPI file service — all retained surfaces. Resolved by ORV-114.
